fr_html: Au cours des débats, les juges posent aux témoins, agents, experts, avocats et conseils toutes questions qu'ils estiment utiles; les agents, avocats et conseils ont le droit de poser, par l'entremise du Président, toute question que la Cour juge utile.
en_html: During the hearing in Court, the judges may put any questions considered by them to be necessary, to the witnesses, agents, experts, advocates or counsel. The agents, advocates and counsel shall have the right to ask, through the President, any questions that the Court considers useful.
